promotion_rule.primary_metric: mean file-level Macro-F1 across four simulated held-out loads
promotion_rule.class_recall_rule: A candidate must not introduce a zero class recall on a simulated load where no-transfer recall for that class was nonzero.
promotion_rule.selection_data: simulated source-held-out target only; never A-P truth
promotion_rule.stop_rule: At most two additional candidate families after A1. Stop if neither satisfies the predeclared rule; retain no-transfer source model for target reporting.

candidates.problem_targeted: large marginal location/scale shift, especially absolute amplitude and spectral/envelope statistics
candidates.target_input_used: all unlabeled target windows only for file-balanced feature means and standard deviations
candidates.extra_assumption: dominant shift is approximately feature-wise affine and not strongly class-conditional
candidates.status_in_step08: actually evaluated on simulated held-out loads; not promoted to A-P as a final method in STEP08

candidates.problem_targeted: cross-feature covariance shift not handled by independent moment matching
candidates.extra_assumption: a global second-order linear alignment preserves class structure sufficiently
candidates.status_in_step08: design only; defer real target adaptation

candidates.problem_targeted: only a subset of source files/windows may resemble the target distribution
candidates.target_input_used: unlabeled target domain membership to fit a domain classifier; target fault labels not used
candidates.extra_assumption: covariate-shift style reweighting is meaningful and source support overlaps target support
candidates.status_in_step08: design only; defer real target adaptation
